title: Scrollable test case detail pane
requirement: Long test-case details must be vertically scrollable so every section can be reached in the fixed-height panel.
reason: Scroll behaviour at real panel heights requires a live browser surface that is being implemented now.
steps: Open a case with a long requirement, many steps, evidence and history.
Scroll the detail pane from top to bottom.
Reach the final action without the content being clipped or the page itself scrolling unexpectedly.
expected: The detail column scrolls independently through the entire requirement, steps, expected outcome, evidence, history and actions without clipping at desktop or narrow widths.

history.notes: Observed in the real Tasks → Test cases panel; usability-proof.mjs exit 0
